data.raw_response:
=== Morphological Assessment Form ===
A. Leaf Arrangement & Architecture
    1. Leaf relative position (alternate / opposite / whorled): whorled (three leaves clearly attached at the same node, visible in close-up images)
    2. Leaf spacing (clustered / distal): clustered (leaves are grouped closely at the apex of the stem)

B. Leaf Complexity
    3. Leaf complexity (simple / compound): simple (each leaf is a single blade without divisions into leaflets)
    4. Compound leaf type, ONLY if leaf complexity is compound (odd-pinnate / even-pinnate): N/A
    5. Number of leaflets (integer estimate 2, 4, 8, …): N/A
    6. Leaflet arrangement (opposite / alternate / subopposite): N/A

C. Leaf Morphology
    7. Leaf margin (entire / toothed) AND if toothed (dentate, serrate, etc.)): entire (smooth margin with no teeth or serrations visible)
    8. Leaf shape (elliptic, obovate, lanceolate, etc.): elliptic (broadest near the middle, tapering to both ends)
    9. Leaf apex (acute, obtuse, acuminate): acute (tapering to a sharp point)
    10. Leaf base (rounded, cordate, cuneate): rounded (base is broad and gently curved)
    11. Venation type (pinnate / palmate / parallel): pinnate (main vein runs from base to apex with lateral veins branching off)
    12. Secondary veins (visibility, spacing, number): visible, moderately spaced, several pairs (secondary veins are clearly visible and run from midrib to margin)
    13. Leaf surface features (glabrous, shiny, dull, rugose): dull, rugose (surface is not shiny, with slight wrinkling or uneven texture)
    14. Leaf surface trichomes (present / absent): present (fine hairs visible along leaf margins and on leaf surface, especially in close-up)
    15. Petiole length (short / long): short (petiole is short and not elongated)
    16. Petiole features (winged / grooved / terete): terete (circular in cross-section, not flattened or winged)

D. Stem & Shoot Traits
    17. Stem type, may not be visible (woody / herbaceous): herbaceous (stem appears soft and green, not woody)
    18. Stem trichomes (present / absent): present (fine hairs visible on stem surface)
    19. Stem color: green (stem is green, with some darkening near nodes)
    20. Stem texture (smooth / ridged / lenticellate): smooth (no ridges or lenticels visible; surface is uniform)

E. Other Visible Seedling Traits
    21. Stipules, sometimes visible only in close-up images (present / absent): absent (no stipules observed at leaf bases)
    22. Latex, rarely visible but extremely diagnostic when present (present / not observed): not observed (no latex exudate visible)
    23. Pulvinus, for Fabaceae family only (present / absent): absent (no swollen base at leaf petiole attachment)
    24. Tendrils (present / absent): absent (no tendrils visible)

F. Notes: Some leaves show small holes, likely from damage, but cause is not determinable. The plant is a young seedling with a whorled leaf arrangement at the apex. The fine trichomes are visible on both leaves and stem, especially in close-up images. The pink tag is an artificial marker and not part of the plant.
